eras.title: A sanctuary on the mountainside
eras.caption: Delphi's sanctuary occupied steep terraces beneath the cliffs of Parnassus. Excavation revealed the temple foundations, treasuries and paths used by visitors who came to consult Apollo's oracle and leave offerings.
